set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system authentication-order [paramet.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

set system radius-server [parameter1].explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

port [parameter2].explanation: Configures the RADIUS server with `[parameter1]` as the server address and `[parameter2]` as the port number for authentication and accounting communication.

parameters.name: port
parameters.explanation: Port number for the RADIGUS server.

secret [parameter3].explanation: Configure the IP address, port and shared key of the RADIUS server.

set routing-options rib [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment creates or modifies a custom Routing Information Base (RIB) named `[parameter1]` within the routing options, allowing for separate routing tables.

static route [parameter2] [parameter3].explanation: Configures a static route where `[parameter2]` is the destination network and `[parameter3]` is the next-hop IP address or interface.

parameters.name: route
parameters.explanation: The IPv6 prefix for a static route.

parameters.name: next-hop
parameters.explanation: The next-hop address, here it is set to discard.

set access address-assignment pool [para.explanation: This command fragment configures an address-assignment pool named `[parameter1]` for dynamic IP address allocation in Junos.

family inet6 prefix [parameter2].explanation: The command `family inet6 prefix [parameter2]` configures an IPv6 address family and specifies a prefix (parameter2) for routing or filtering in Junos.

prefix-length [parameter3].explanation: The command `prefix-length [parameter3]` specifies the subnet mask length for an IP address or route, defining the number of network bits in the prefix.

encapsulation [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of envelope for the sub-interface.

vlan-id [parameter3].explanation: Configure an interface with a VLAN bridge and specify VLAN ID.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet6 address [parameter3].explanation: The command `family inet6 address [parameter3]` configures an IPv6 address (`[parameter3]`) on an interface in Junos OS.

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: The address configuration method here is automatic configuration.

family inet6 address [parameter2] [param.explanation: Configures an IPv6 address (`[parameter2]`) with an optional prefix length (`[parameter3]`) on an interface in the `inet6` address family.

parameters.name: eui-64
parameters.explanation: The command explanation is: Use the EUI-64 format to generate the interface identifier.

family inet6 address [parameter2].explanation: The command `family inet6 address [parameter2]` configures an IPv6 address (`[parameter2]`) on an interface in Junos OS.

parameters.name: address
parameters.explanation: The address configuration method here is automatic configuration.
